title: How Highways Almost Destroyed Amsterdam - Plan Jokinen
summary: A short Not Just Bikes video on the 1960s plans (Plan Jokinen) to cut highways through Amsterdam to accommodate cars. It shows how radically different the city would look had they succeeded.
why: HN commenters cite it as a concise illustration of how the Netherlands narrowly avoided car-centric planning and then built its bike culture.

quote.text: about those plans, the fightback in the 1970s, and the resulting bike culture that Amsterdam has today.
